messages:
Anu Patel: quick check — for the inference-routing launch I want a concise decision on commercial readiness. I sketched the gating matrix (SLA scope, docs minimum, oncall handoff, telemetry sampling, pricing bands). proposing: Tier A (hosted) -> partial SLA p99=300ms, Tier B -> best-effort with strong docs. thoughts?
Josh Li: partial SLA sounds reasonable. we need clarity on what endpoints are covered (streaming vs non-streaming). measurement method matters.
Maria Gonzales: agree. Also: onboarding docs must include sample cURL + SDK snippet and 'expected costs' section. can we commit to that by EOD Wed?
Kevin O'Neill: for telemetry: we should set sampling to 1% for full traces, 10% for latency-only histograms at launch. otherwise alert noise will drown ops.
Zoe Harper: pricing bands — we should avoid hard per-token tiers at day 1. propose 'beta pricing window' with soft caps + opt-in quota limits for early customers. reduces bill shock.
Anu Patel: Josh — for measurement: propose p99 for end-to-end request completion (includes any stream finalization). we will treat streaming p95 separately in the doc.
Josh Li: ok, clarify: p99 measured on server-complete events, not client observed time. add that to the SLA text.
Maria Gonzales: Docs checklist (short): 1) Quickstart cURL + SDK 2) Migration notes for Dedicated -> Hosted 3) Sample cost calculator 4) Ops playbook snippet for timeouts/50x. I'll own 1 and 3.
Kevin O'Neill: Oncall: we should map routes to two rotation tiers. Tier A incidents -> oncall infra team; Tier B -> product oncall. add explicit escalation matrix. I can draft the runbook paragraph.
product-bot: Deploy note: staging rollout for routing rules succeeded at 1718844499. No errors flagged. :white_check_mark:
Zoe Harper: commercial ask — sales wants a short blurb for contracts: "Partial SLA: measurable latency commitments for Tier A; financial credits TBD and case-by-case". we should keep the legal wording intentionally noncommittal until finance signs off.
Anu Patel: Decision proposal: ship with partial SLA as described, docs minimal shipping items owned (Maria+Anu), telemetry sampling as Kevin suggested, pricing soft bands (Zoe). Owners check in tomorrow 10am. any objections?
Josh Li: no objections. I'll add the exact p99 definition and include a sample query we can run in the metrics UI.
Maria Gonzales: on it. ETA for docs first draft: tomorrow 6pm PT.
Kevin O'Neill: I'll drop runbook paragraph by EOD today and add the sampling knobs to the telemetry dashboard.
Zoe Harper: I'll draft the commercial blurb and coordinate with finance.
Anu Patel: cool — final call: proceed with the plan. owners will mark any hard blockers here. :thumbsup:
